verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an official MCP server at developers.pomelo.la/mcp, with one-click and manual install instructions for Cursor. It exposes tools that search API endpoints by Spanish or English query and generate request code examples, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP page exists. Missing for 10: MCP tools that act on live platform resources (cards, users, transactions) rather than only documentation and code lookup, documented setup for clients beyond Cursor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
